formats.key: deployVault(uint256 initialDeposit, uint256 maxManagementFee, uint256 maxPerformanceFee)
effects: Pulls initialDeposit WETH from the signer into the deployer, which needs a prior WETH approval, and deposits it into the newly cloned vault.
Mints teWETH vault shares to the signer for the deposit. PlasmaVault.deposit(initialDeposit, msg.sender) sets this; the share amount comes from the vault.
Grants the signer WHITELIST_ROLE on the new vault.
OWNER, ATOMIST, GUARDIAN, ALPHA, FUSE_MANAGER and rewards roles over the vault holding the signer's deposit go to addresses the deployer owner set. The signer gets no admin role.

Sets the vault's management and performance fees from deployer storage, paid to feeRecipient. Reverts if they are above maxManagementFee or maxPerformanceFee. A DAO fee package from storage also applies.
formats.shown: Deploy Vault: ticker teWETH, an initial deposit of 0.02 WETH, and max management and performance fees of 0.25% and 30%.

findings.title: deployVault intent 'Deploy Vault' leaves out that the signer deposits WETH and receives shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent "Deploy Vault", interpolatedIntent absent. The code runs safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, ..., initialDeposit) and PlasmaVault.deposit(initialDeposit, msg.sender). Case 0 moves 0.02 WETH out and teWETH in.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Deploy teWETH vault and deposit {initialDeposit}", or set intent to "Deploy vault and deposit WETH".

findings.title: deployVault grants the signer WHITELIST_ROLE on the new vault, and the screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: TesseractVaultDeployer.sol _deployVault: accessManager.grantRole(Roles.WHITELIST_ROLE, msg.sender, 0). No field or intent mentions the role. Not critical: the role is the access needed for the vault being deployed (not_critical #12/#13).
findings.fix: Mention in the intent or a label that the signer is whitelisted as depositor of the new vault, for example "Deploy vault (you are whitelisted depositor)".

findings.title: deployVault: Tesseract-set addresses, not the signer, own and operate the vault that holds the deposit.
findings.evidence: _deployVault: grantRole(OWNER_ROLE, vaultOwner), grantRole(ATOMIST_ROLE, atomist), grantRole(ALPHA_ROLE, alpha), GUARDIAN_ROLE to guardian, all from storage. In case 0 the reader was unsure who controls the vault.
findings.fix: Storage values cannot be shown. A label or intent wording such as "Deploy Tesseract-managed vault" would set expectations.

findings.title: deployVault: actual fee rates, the fee recipient, the DAO fee package and the redemption delay come from storage.
findings.evidence: _deployVault uses managementFee, performanceFee, feeRecipient, daoFeePackageIndex and REDEMPTION_DELAY_IN_SECONDS from storage. The screen shows only the user's max fee bounds, which the code enforces.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The max-fee labels are correct bounds.

findings.title: deployVault: the number of teWETH shares received is not shown. The vault decides it at deposit.
findings.evidence: Case 0: the signer receives 2000000000000000000 teWETH (decimals 20), and no field shows the amount. The screen only shows the ticker 'teWETH'.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the share amount. Wording like "receive teWETH shares" in the intent helps.

cases.notes: 0.02 WETH out is shown exactly. teWETH shares in: only the ticker is shown, with no amount and no explicit recipient. The reader inferred shares to self but did not know the amount.

formats.key: deployVaultWithPermit(uint256 initialDeposit, uint256 maxManagementFee, uint256 maxPerformanceFee, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
effects: Tries WETH.permit(signer, deployer, initialDeposit, deadline, v, r, s). If that fails, it requires an existing allowance of at least initialDeposit.
Pulls initialDeposit WETH from the signer and deposits it into the newly cloned vault.
Mints teWETH vault shares to the signer.
Grants the signer WHITELIST_ROLE on the new vault.
Admin roles over the vault go to Tesseract-configured addresses. Fees from storage, bounded by the max fee inputs, are set with feeRecipient.
formats.shown: Deploy Vault (Permit): ticker teWETH, the initial deposit in WETH, max management and performance fees, and the permit deadline.

findings.title: deployVaultWithPermit intent leaves out the WETH deposit and the shares received.
findings.evidence: intent "Deploy Vault (Permit)", no interpolatedIntent. _deployVault pulls initialDeposit from msg.sender and deposits to msg.sender.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Deploy teWETH vault and deposit {initialDeposit}".

findings.title: deployVaultWithPermit grants the signer WHITELIST_ROLE on the new vault, and the screen does not say so.
findings.fix: Mention the depositor whitelisting in the intent.

findings.title: deployVaultWithPermit: WETH9 has no permit, so 'Permit deadline' suggests a permit that does nothing.
findings.evidence: deployVaultWithPermit: try IERC20Permit(UNDERLYING_TOKEN).permit(...). Mainnet WETH9 (0xC02a...) has no permit. Its payable fallback calls deposit() and succeeds silently, so the tx only works with a prior approve. The descriptor shows the field 'Permit deadline'.
findings.fix: Consider a note that WETH needs a prior approval, or drop the deadline field for this WETH-bound deployer.

findings.title: deployVaultWithPermit: vault control, actual fees, recipient and share amount come from storage or the vault.
findings.evidence: _deployVault: roles granted to vaultOwner/atomist/alpha/guardian, fees from managementFee/performanceFee to feeRecipient, shares from PlasmaVault.deposit.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. Wording like "Tesseract-managed vault" could help.
